contrastDescription: Paired contrast cases, labeled BEFORE any Jev run. Each pair changes one variable (data supplied vs. fetched from Git; display name vs. recovery code) and stays on the same side of the local 100-character threshold with no local keyword hits, so the local classifier answers standard for all eight by design. Read pair separation, not overall accuracy. Labels are PROVISIONAL.
